objective: Extend the existing mobile appearance system with Liquid, Matte and Solid Glass presets; preserve every existing customization control and functional contract
acceptance_criteria: Liquid is the default dark emerald material; all three presets share the existing Glass component
Only three appearance choices are added; existing dark and contrast controls and profile actions remain
Material changes persist without changing routing, account or unrelated preferences
Material levels are readable, distinct and respect reduced motion and enhanced contrast
Responsive UI, keyboard theme selection, panels and route interaction pass runtime checks
Typecheck, regression tests and platform exports pass; original 141 files remain unchanged

baseline.source: 141 original files and all protected copies match

decision.action: Add pure preset tokens to the existing ThemeProvider, shared Glass, and three preview choices inside existing settings
evidence: AccountScreens.tsx owns Dark appearance and ContrastSlider
Glass.tsx uses 0.16–0.70 outer opacity and pale nested highlights
All service screens already consume Glass/Copy/Action
decision.risk: Shared material contrast and native blur behavior need platform exports and browser verification
